sources.role: Long daily rainfall, temperature, and solar backbone; record actual parameters, time standard, product-specific native grid, coverage and QA.
sources.license_review: Reviewed 2026-11-04: the Registry of Open Data on AWS lists NASA POWER as CC BY 4.0, says there are no restrictions on use/access/download, and requests citation. Preserve NASA POWER attribution and check any underlying source-product notices. Sources: https://registry.opendata.aws/nasa-power/ and https://power.larc.nasa.gov/docs/acknowledgements/.
sources.state: Partial implementation: UTC daily POWER history provider and versioned JSON plus Parquet caches for 2001–2025 at Dhaka, Chattogram, and Rajshahi representative reference points. Standard meteorology grid is 0.5° × 0.625°; solar is 1° × 1°. These are not district means or field measurements. Normalizer v2; nationwide 64-district coverage and QA release remain open.
